responsibility: This implementation module implements the Logitech-style packed date/time abstraction using host libc and Selective services. It fetches wall-clock time via time/localtime and gettimeofday-style helpers, encodes day, minute, and millisecond fields into the legacy Time record, compares and zeroes those records, and formats them as yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss strings with DynamicStrings and FormatStrings support.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of TimeDate: it realizes the interface declared in the same-stem .def file using libc, DynamicStrings, FormatStrings, and Selective to fetch, encode, compare, zero, and format Time values.
